description: MULTIPLY a winning video ad into N variants: each gets a NEW character, outfit, location and/or objects while the cut, the camera motion, the pacing and the ORIGINAL AUDIO stay exactly as they were, and the source's own captions and on-screen text stay exactly as they are. ONE JOB PER VARIANT: get_job each until done; never describe a variant before its URL arrives. COST: quoteOnly:true returns the exact credits free: state that first. A paid planning read (planCredits) runs next, then each variant bills perVariantCredits. dryRun:true pays for that read; pass its `plan` back to render without paying again. No ad: list_winning_ads. New words: rewrite_ad_line. Full rules: get_instructions({topic:'multiply_ad'}).

axes.description: what to vary: character, outfit, location, objects (default all four), or your own, e.g. "season"

change.description: what should change, in the user's own words, e.g. 'older women, winter streets'; every variant applies it (omit to let the variants vary freely)

dryRun.description: true = the paid plan and the price, no render

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

images.description: up to 9 pictures to put in the variants, in the order @Image1, @Image2 name them: URLs or local paths

role.description: what it is, in your words, e.g. "our founder"

notes.description: anything the variants must respect, e.g. "keep it women 25-40", "no gyms"

plan.description: the `plan` a dryRun returned, rendered without planning again

quality.description: 1080p is the default; 720p costs less, and hands holding a product are less reliable at 720p

quoteOnly.description: true = the exact credits, free; nothing runs

regions.description: markets to restyle for, one or more variants each, e.g. ["Berlin","Tokyo","São Paulo"] — visuals only; audio is never translated here

start.description: instead of video: an id from list_winning_ads

useBrand.description: false = send no brand product photo (for a video that is not this workspace brand)

video.description: the source video: a file URL, or a TikTok, Reel, Facebook or X post link (not YouTube)

name: multiply_ad
title: Multiply an ad
